name: dq_scorecard
description: Daily completeness and validity per dataset, zone and source sequence, from the newest data quality run.

columns.name: zone_key
columns.description: Bidding zone key from the zone registry.

columns.name: is_primary
columns.description: True for the SDAC price series and for load.

columns.name: expected_minutes
columns.description: Minutes in the local day (DST aware).

columns.name: validity_ratio
columns.description: Valid rows / rows (null when there are no rows).

columns.name: dq_run_id
columns.description: Data quality run that produced the row.

constraints: validity_ratio IS NULL OR validity_ratio BETWEEN 0 AND 1
